links.outcome: Image-level uncertainty score detecting real-world severe artifacts in synthesized MRI
links.effect: Uncertainty score achieved AUC of 0.9053 and recall of 81.82% at a false-positive rate of 4.69% for severe artifact detection.
links.quote: In real-world severe artifact detection, the image-level uncertainty score achieved an AUC of 0.9053 and a recall of 81.82% at a false-positive rate of 4.69%.

unlisted_practices: Physics-constrained synthesis (differentiable Bloch layer) to reduce hallucinations in generative MRI
Uncertainty-based three-tier risk routing (auto-pass, human review, reject) for AI-generated images

screen.reason: The study designs and empirically evaluates an automated uncertainty-based risk tiering and quality control guardrail (triaging images into auto-pass, human review, or rejection) for MRI image synthesis, tested with blinded clinical reader assessment.

primary.practice: automated quality control and risk tiering
